_comment: Source of truth for warrenlabs.com plugin landing pages. tools/gen_site.py renders web/<slug>/index.html + web/index.html from this. tools/new_plugin.sh appends an entry on scaffold. Fluency/foundation builds (e.g. Curve, Press codenames) are intentionally NOT listed. Only shipping lane products get public pages. Names marked 'pending' are working names not yet vetted; pages are staging until the name locks.

plugins.name: Level
plugins.blurb: Flattens a headphone's measured response by inverting its curve, then adds Bauer-style crossfeed so a mix translates the way speakers would. Every curve says who measured it, and six of them are ours, taken on a rig we own. The signal comes out measurably corrected, honest before anything else.
features: Six headphones measured on our own rig, badged not borrowed
Bauer crossfeed with interaural delay, loudness-neutral within 0.05 dB
Output metering with a latched clip indicator, and Safe Gain
Monitoring checks: flip, polarity, dim, mono
Voicing + RTA layer · VST3 / AU / Standalone

shots.alt: Level's faceplate: response plot, provenance line, output meter, CHECK cluster
shots.caption: The main view. The headphone and where its measurement came from read first, then the curve, then the level it produces.

shots.alt: Level's headphone library with a MEASURED BY column
shots.caption: Every curve says who measured it.
A latched check is never silent about itself.

shots.alt: Level's output meter showing a latched OVER state
shots.caption: The clip indicator latches until you acknowledge it.

plugins.name: Square
plugins.blurb: Sums the bass to mono below a crossover, auditions the result, and shows you the stereo field, goniometer and correlation, so the low end holds up everywhere it's played.

shots.alt: Square's faceplate: goniometer, correlation meter, crossover readout and BASS MONO engaged
shots.caption: The goniometer and correlation meter, with the bass-mono crossover at 120 Hz.

plugins.name: Scribe
plugins.tagline: Scribe a tonal fit to target.
plugins.blurb: Learns a reference's per-band tonal balance and pulls your program toward it, broad and musical rather than surgical. Audition modes flip the same plugin into a translation check: hear the mix coloured like a phone, earbuds, a laptop or a car before you commit to the render.
features: Learn a reference curve from anything playing
Tilt + smoothing for a broad tonal fit
Audition modes: Phone / Earbuds / Laptop / Car

shots.alt: Scribe's faceplate: tonal fit curve against a flat-plus-tilt target, with the translation mode row
shots.caption: Match mode against a flat + tilt target. The row along the bottom auditions the same mix on phone, earbuds, laptop and car.

plugins.name: Pare
plugins.tagline: Tame what rings, leave the rest.
plugins.blurb: A dense dynamic filterbank that cuts resonant bands only where and when they spike. Transparent when nothing's ringing, minimum-phase, no pre-ringing. A focus mode scopes the same engine to sibilance or low-mid mud, so one tool covers resonance, de-essing and de-mudding. A delta monitor shows exactly what's removed.
features: Focus modes: Full Range / De-ess / De-mud / Custom

shots.alt: Pare with a custom focus range
shots.caption: Custom focus.

plugins.name: Bevel
plugins.blurb: A clean six-band parametric EQ with a real-time analyzer, surgical when you need it, musical when you don't. It shapes the tonal balance without a voice of its own, so what you hear is the move you made and nothing else.
features: Six bands: shelves, peaks, pass filters
Draggable nodes on a log-freq plot

shots.alt: Bevel's faceplate: a six-band parametric EQ curve with draggable band handles over a ±12 dB grid
shots.caption: Six bands, dragged straight on the curve. Wheel sets Q, double-click bypasses a band.

plugins.name: Brace
plugins.blurb: A compressor with three voices: a clean VCA-style grip, a fast FET bite, and a smooth optical glue. It braces the dynamics where they need it and gets out of the way where they don't.

shots.alt: Brace's faceplate: compression transfer curve with the knee drawn, CLEAN/FET/OPTO models, and the control row
shots.caption: The transfer curve draws the knee as you set it. Here, Clean at 4:1 over a −18 dB threshold, 6 dB knee.

plugins.name: Temper
plugins.tagline: Controlled heat, all the way up.
plugins.blurb: One oversampled waveshaper, six models, from tube warmth and tape compression through transformer iron to diode overdrive, crunch and full fuzz. Bias sets the harmonic character, a velcro gate makes the dirt sputter and die with the note.
features: Six models: Tube / Tape / Transformer / Diode / Crunch / Fuzz
Bias for even-vs-odd harmonics + velcro gate

shots.alt: Temper's faceplate: saturation transfer curve with all six models listed, Tube selected
shots.caption: One saturation engine, six models from Tube through Fuzz. The transfer curve shows what the drive is actually doing.

plugins.name: Ripple
plugins.blurb: A modulated stereo echo with tape and BBD character, ping-pong and tempo sync, plus chorus, flanger and phaser on the same interpolated-delay core. The control set follows the engine you pick rather than relabelling the same knobs.
features: Echo: tape / BBD character, ping-pong, tempo sync

shots.alt: Ripple's faceplate: echo train showing decaying taps, Tape character, and the Echo/Chorus/Flanger/Phaser mode row
shots.caption: The echo train draws every tap and its decay. Tape character, and the same delay core runs chorus, flanger and phaser.

plugins.name: Wake
plugins.tagline: The space a sound leaves behind.
plugins.blurb: An algorithmic FDN reverb and a convolution engine in one: six bundled spaces from tight rooms to cathedrals, or load your own impulse response. A modulated tail stays lush without turning metallic.

shots.alt: Wake's faceplate: impulse response display with RT60 readout, Hall preset, and the algorithmic/convolution toggle
shots.caption: The impulse response, drawn. ALGO runs the FDN; CONV plays a captured space, and you can load your own IR.

guides.title: Capturing your own reverb (impulse responses)
guides.summary: Sample the reverb of a real room, your studio or a hall, and load it into a convolution reverb.

guides.title: Level manual
guides.summary: What every control does, what Safe Gain actually guarantees, and what Level deliberately does not do.

bundles.name: The Reference Desk
bundles.tagline: Everything you need to hear the mix honestly.
bundles.blurb: Five corrective and diagnostic tools on one shared engine: metering that shows what the low end really does, an EQ and a compressor, a resonance suppressor that also de-esses and de-muds, and a matching EQ that doubles as a translation check.

bundles.name: The Character Collection
bundles.blurb: Three colour tools, each covering a whole corner: six saturation models from tube warmth to full fuzz, echo plus chorus/flanger/phaser on one delay core, and a reverb that runs both an FDN and real captured spaces.

wholeLab.name: The Whole Lab
wholeLab.tagline: Every Warren Labs plugin, one install.
wholeLab.blurb: Every Warren Labs plugin in one install: the Trueness and Character lines together, on one shared engine.
